entry.content:
Union Glashütte's Belisar Chronograph Speedster takes its cue from a rare classic in Mainz artist Markus Haub's collection, and its beige, high-gloss lacquered dial with black subdials and orange accents gives the 40mm steel case an automotive-inspired look. The automatic chronograph movement is built by hand in Glashütte, where it is also finished and regulated, stores at least 65 hours of power and uses a silicon balance spring that resists magnetic fields. It is paired with a black calfskin strap perforated for racing, is water resistant to 328 feet, and is limited to 288 numbered pieces.

entry.content:
Jean-Michel Basquiat's Untitled (Leonardo and His Five Grotesque Heads) is a bright orange, 84-inch-square canvas from 1983 that riffs on the grotesque heads of Leonardo da Vinci. Basquiat reproduces all five heads from a drawing Leonardo made around 1493, but where Leonardo gave his caricatures bodies, Basquiat reduces them to a slimy grin, an ape-like grimace and a mouth in full howl, and in one corner a pink patch reads "ALTER EGO," a reference to himself. "We see him improvising off the great Master," says Ana Maria Celis, the auction house's head of post-war and contemporary art. The painting has been out of public view in a private European collection for more than two decades and is now up for auction.

entry.content:
McLaren Racing is selling five of the Formula One cars in its Heritage Collection because, as CEO Zak Brown puts it, "These cars were built to be driven and raced, and we want to see them being used and enjoyed." The oldest are a pair of 1991 MP4/6As, chassis 4 and 7, from the season Ayrton Senna won his third and final championship, both with Senna and Gerhard Berger history. The group also includes a 2012 MP4/27A, the 2021 MCL35M that Lando Norris drove onto the podium at Monaco in Gulf livery, and the newest car, the MCL37A, which Brad Pitt drove at the Circuit of the Americas while filming F1. Each car is being offered individually.

entry.content:
Cadillac's Collector Series is a run of limited-edition V-Series models, each capped at a stated number of units, from the 120-unit CT5-V Blackwing 120th Anniversary Edition to the 26-unit CT5-V Blackwing F1 Collector Series. Now, the Escalade-V 125th Anniversary Collector Series is the first Escalade to join the series and the vehicle that kickstarts Cadillac's 125th anniversary year. It pairs the model's supercharged 6.2-liter V8, rated at 682 horsepower, with forged 24-inch wheels, carbon-fiber trim on the grille surround, mirror caps, rear fascia and engine cover, and blue brake calipers. Santorini Blue, drawn from the Mondrian pattern in the V-Series emblem, appears on the stitching and seat belts of the black and Sheer Gray cabin, and buyers can choose their own VIN and serial number from a run of just 252.

entry.content:
Yozma Sport electrifies off-road riding with its latest electric dirt bike, built for trail adventures and stunt riding. The Yozma IN 11 Electric Dirt Bike is powered by a 4,800W peak mid-drive motor delivering 200 Nm of torque and speeds up to 45 mph, while a 52V 27Ah battery provides up to 55 miles of range. Four selectable riding modes adjust power delivery and torque to match different skill levels and terrain, allowing riders to build confidence as their experience grows. Modes 1-3 offer varying levels of performance, while Mode 4 unlocks One-Tap Wheelie and Smart-Wheelie Assist for assisted front-wheel lifts. Dual hydraulic brakes, a hydraulic front fork, and rear shock help maintain stability across uneven terrain, while an adjustable LED dashboard keeps essential riding information in view. Complete with a reverse gear and high-visibility brake light, the IN 11 offers a balance of accessible performance and off-road capability for riders of varying experience levels.

entry.summary: Ford's Custom Garage ORV package turns a four-door Bronco into a more capable trail rig, installed by a Ford dealer as a single package so there is no parts list to piece together. A Fox off-road suspension kit adds ground clearance and improves articulation, which helps the Bron
entry.content:
Ford's Custom Garage ORV package turns a four-door Bronco into a more capable trail rig, installed by a Ford dealer as a single package so there is no parts list to piece together. A Fox off-road suspension kit adds ground clearance and improves articulation, which helps the Bronco clear obstacles and keep its tires on the ground over uneven terrain, while skid and fuel tank plates borrowed from the Bronco Raptor shield the underbody. Trail armor guards the rocker panels, RIGID auxiliary lights illuminate the trail after dark, and black 17-inch Weld wheels and wider Havoc fender flares give the exterior a broader, darker stance. Ford offers the package as a limited edition on Base, Big Bend, and Outer Banks trims.
